column1: # EVIDENCE MANIFEST - the 99 promotable untyped function-pointer slots.
# THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK-CONSUMABLE MANIFEST AND HAS NO SPEC, DELIBERATELY.
# tools/GhidraApplyCohortManifest.java has exactly six verbs - SET_NAME,
# REMOVE_STALE_BOOKMARK - and NONE of them can define or type data.  Verified in
# the source rather than assumed: the only `PointerDataType` use in the whole
# applier is `getPointer` while building a parameter TYPE for SET_PROTOTYPE, and
# there is no `createData`, no `DataUtilities`, no `setDataType` and no
# `addMemoryReference` anywhere in it.  Typing an .rdata/.data dword is the
# capability this cohort needs and the framework lacks, so per the standing rule
# this lane STOPPED rather than inventing a seventh verb or a new applier.  A
# spec is deliberately absent because any spec written today would have to
# declare a verb that does not exist.
# NOTE ON THIS COMMENT BLOCK.  The framework's manifest reader treats line 0 as
# the column header and does NOT skip `#` lines (only the SPEC reader does).  If a
# data verb ever lands, this block must move into the spec and be deleted from
# here, or GATE 4 will refuse on header drift.
# PROVENANCE.  Rows are the 99 `action=ADD` rows of
# ADD, 12 UNRESOLVED, zero retype).  That input hash was re-derived here and
# matches.  The 12 UNRESOLVED rows are excluded and are listed at the bottom of
# this file as comments with their reason.
# MEASURED BY THIS LANE on a replica restored from
#   * safety, INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED - all 99 slots report status=UNDEFINED
#     under tools/DiagnoseAddressListingState.java: no data at the slot, no
#     defined data containing it, no instruction at or containing it, no function
#     containing it.  Zero violations.  65 slots are in .rdata, 34 in .data.
#     finds exactly 29 of the 99 slots referenced from inside a function body
#     (42 INDIRECTION + 3 DATA references over 44 distinct reading functions);
#     the other 70 have no inbound reference at all.
#   * effect, MEASURED on a throwaway replica - typing all 99 as `pointer` moves
#     function-inventory diff shows NO function row moved on any column.
#   * decompilation drift, MEASURED before and after on that replica for all 44
#     reading functions - 44 of 44 change and the change is strictly an
#     improvement: total decompiled lines 1098 -> 1050 because the
#     "Globals starting with '_' overlap smaller symbols at the same address"
#     was observed in any of the 44.
# THE RESIDUAL RISK IS REAL AND IS NOT A HYPOTHETICAL.  The named risk was that
# pre-typing individual dwords could block a later RTTI structure application over
# the same bytes.  Measured from pristine bytes by walking each slot's maximal run
# of consecutive aligned .text-entry dwords and resolving the dword before the run
# head as an MSVC Complete Object Locator (COL -> +0x0C type descriptor -> +0x08
# mangled name): 65 of the 99 slots sit inside a PROVEN RTTI vftable, implicating
# 59 distinct classes.  Run lengths are 706 (3 slots), 46 (15), 24 (12), 9 (3),
# 7 (1), 3 (12), 2 (51), 1 (2).  So the majority of this cohort is not "loose
# pointers Ghidra missed" - it is vftable entries, and the higher-value mutation
# is to apply the vftable with its recovered class identity rather than to add 99
# isolated dwords.  `rttiVftableClass` below carries the class per row so that
# decision can be made per row instead of in bulk.
# The `pointer` type used for the measurement is the generic 4-byte pointer, NOT a

# entry-pointer dword with no adjacent typed slot, so the neighbourhood argument
# that carries the 99 does not carry them; they need their own evidence.
